meta.title: You actually weigh less in this one specific spot on Earth #shorts
meta.description:
Did you know you can instantly lose weight just by traveling to Canada? It sounds like a scam, but it’s actual physics. In the Hudson Bay region, gravity is literally broken. If you stand there, you weigh about a tenth of an ounce less than anywhere else on Earth. For decades, scientists were completely baffled by this missing gravity. They eventually discovered two mind-blowing causes. First, during the last ice age, a massive ice sheet over two miles thick crushed the Earth’s crust, pushing it down like a sponge. The ground is still slowly rebounding today, meaning there is less mass under your feet. Deep underground magma is also dragging the crust downward. Would you move here to weigh less, or is this just too weird? Let me know in the comments and hit follow!
